items.passage0: In Stardew Valley, my farmer grows potatoes in spring and corn in summer. Corn is great because it keeps growing in fall, too. When my farmer is tired, he eats some food to get his energy back. He sells most of his vegetables, but he always keeps some corn in his bag for a snack.
items.passage1: Every morning, I eat cereal with milk and a guava. My brother doesn't like cereal, so he eats a cheese sandwich. On Sundays, Mom makes pancakes with flour, eggs and milk. We put honey on them. They are soft and sweet. Sunday breakfast is the best!
items.passage2: Kevin loves fast food. Last month, he ate fried chicken and hamburgers and drank milk shakes almost every day. He often felt tired and sleepy in class. The school nurse told him to change his diet. Now Kevin brings a lunch box from home with rice, tofu and vegetables. He feels much better.
items.passage3: Last Saturday, my family went to a small restaurant. I looked at the menu and ordered beef noodles. My sister wanted fried rice, but they didn't have any. So she had dumplings. Dad put some vinegar on his dumplings. "It makes them taste better," he said. After dinner, we were all very full.
items.passage4: In our town game, Nora is the baker. Every morning, she bakes ten loaves of bread with flour, milk and honey. Jack brings her fresh fish, and she gives him a loaf of warm bread. This week, the town is building a restaurant. Nora wants to write a menu with healthy food for everyone.
